bio.text: Aaron Gies, a St. Bonaventure University professor, won the Democratic primary on June 23, 2026 for New York's 23rd Congressional District and will face Republican Rep. Nick Langworthy in the November 3 general election.
His 2026 campaign is his first run for political office, according to WSKG's July 2025 coverage of his candidacy announcement.

sources.title: Gies wins Democratic nomination for NY-23 seat, will face Rep. Nick Langworthy
Two Democrats vying for chance to challenge Southern Tier Rep. Nick Langworthy in midterms
